headline: Arihant Capital Markets Limited: Scheme of Arrangement disclosed to NSE
sum: Arihant Capital Markets Limited filed a Scheme of Arrangement disclosure with NSE on 29 June 2026. The scheme contemplates a corporate restructuring under Indian company law; specific merger or reorganisation terms were detailed in the filed disclosure.
detail: Arihant Capital Markets Limited, a capital markets intermediary, initiated a Scheme of Arrangement and made formal disclosure to NSE in accordance with Listing Rules. Schemes of Arrangement under the Indian Companies Act typically involve merger, demerger, or reorganisation of one or more companies and require shareholder and creditor approval, followed by NCLT sanction and regulatory sign-off. The disclosure confirms the scheme was in the announced phase as of late June 2026.
